eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 8:10 AM on AUG 23, 2024 Effective until 4:10 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Grand Canyon National Park is searching for a missing 8-year old boy. Canyon Hartley was last seen at Mather Campground at the South Rim around midnight. Canyon is is 4'11" tall. 60 pounds with strawberry blond hair, wearing a blue shirt, underpants, but no shoes.  Might be carrying a stuffed condor toy.  If seen, call 911, or Park Dispatch at 928-638-7805.
